title: dracontomelon edule
intro: Dracontomelon edule, commonly known as Mayasap or Tungai, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating digestive issues, fever, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Dracontomelon edule include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help in protecting against oxidative stress and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
